description: Mistral's EU regional inference endpoint processes eligible inference inputs and outputs within EU and EFTA data centres.
residency_notes: Regional inference controls inference processing location only. Mistral documents that control-plane data can still be handled outside the selected geography.
prompt_training_notes: Mistral says API data is not used for model training by default, subject to its documented Labs-model exception.
regional_pricing_notes: EU regional inference is billed at 1.1x standard list pricing for input, output, cached reads, and cache writes. Batch is unavailable on regional endpoints.

sources.notes: Documents the EU endpoint, processing geography, 10% regional uplift, supported feature limitations, and model-availability requirements.
Documents that Priority Tier can be regional depending on account setup, model, and capacity.

verification.notes: EU endpoint and pricing verified from Mistral documentation. GLM 5.2 EU availability is verified by its model card.
